farm.name: Farmsteads
farm.description: +3 food each season. Terraced on the mountainsides.

mine.name: Mine
mine.description: +15 gold each season. Hills and mountains only.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.description: Train elite regiments here. In your capital it also trains legendary ones.

walls.name: Stone Walls
walls.description: Walls and a small garrison that guard the province.

church.name: Church
church.description: +2 order. Creatures fighting here strike 20% weaker.

hoard.name: Dragon Hoard
hoard.description: +1 order. Raises the interest your treasury can earn by 15 gold.

ring.name: Fairy Ring
ring.description: +2 order. The Hora strikes twice as hard here.

crypt.name: Crypt
crypt.description: +2 order. One more of the fallen rises after victories won here.
